WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_quantity,
        (AVG(derived_product_cost) - AVG(derived_total_cost)) / AVG(derived_total_cost) AS relative_gap
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg_quantity
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    i.avg_quantity,
    i.relative_gap,
    i.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg_quantity AS quantity_above_average
FROM invoice_averages i
CROSS JOIN overall_average o
WHERE i.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_above_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
